description: Auto Hacking Village at DEF CON 24 explores vehicle security, CAN bus exploitation, heavy truck diagnostics, connected car vulnerabilities, and autonomous systems.

talks.title: Javier Vazquez Vidal, Ferdinand Noelscher - CAN i haz car secret plz
talks.teaser: Reverse engineering CAN bus communication protocols and electronic control units to extract proprietary secrets and firmware logic from vehicles.

talks.title: Six Volts and Haystack - Cheap Tools for Hacking Heavy Trucks
talks.teaser: Demonstrating low-cost hardware tools and open-source software for analyzing and injecting traffic on J1939 heavy vehicle networks.

talks.title: Car Hacking Village - Trevor Roest - Using Yard Stick One for FOB Fun
talks.teaser: Using the Yard Stick One sub-1GHz wireless transceiver to capture, analyze, and replay signals from automotive key fobs.

talks.title: Car Hacking Village - Nathan Hoch
talks.teaser: Dissecting event data recorders (EDRs) and diagnostic fault logging in commercial heavy trucks from an accident reconstruction perspective.

talks.title: Car Hacking Village - Nathan Hoch - Hacking the CHV Badge
talks.teaser: An exploration of the electronic hardware design, microcontroller architecture, and hacking challenges built into the Car Hacking Village badge.

talks.title: Car Hacking Village - Ken Munro - The Mitsubishi Hack Explained
talks.teaser: Ken Munro explains the exploitation of the Mitsubishi Outlander PHEV Wi-Fi module, demonstrating remote vehicle control and alarm tampering.

talks.title: Car Hacking Village - Jun Li, Yuan Jian
talks.teaser: A deep dive into cryptographic weaknesses and protocol vulnerabilities discovered in widely deployed automotive immobilizer transponder systems.

talks.title: Car Hacking Village - Jun Li
talks.teaser: Applying deep learning algorithms and recurrent neural networks to CAN bus telemetry for automated intrusion detection and anomaly monitoring.

talks.title: Car Hacking Village - Ben Breckt
talks.teaser: Evaluating vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2X) communication standards, examining message authentication, wireless protocols, and traffic safety implications.

talks.title: Jianhao Liu, Chen Yan, Wenyuan Xu - Can You Trust Autonomous Vehicles?
talks.teaser: Investigating the sensor trustworthiness of autonomous vehicles, evaluating acoustic, optical, and radar spoofing attacks against onboard perception systems.
